name: Faro de Favàritx
description: A lighthouse on a cape of striated black slate that looks like another planet, at the northern edge of the s'Albufera des Grau Natural Park.

planner.shuttleInfo: Car access restricted in summer (1 Jun–31 Oct; brought forward to 15 May in 2026): seasonal bus from Maó (line 43, ~€3.65/trip). Confirm the year's calendar.

imageAlt: Favàritx lighthouse, its black-and-white striped tower at the end of the path
